scope: Two completed read-only remote resource sampling windows; no experiment, GPU compute, process or queue changes by the auditor

sampling.gpu_source: nvidia-smi utilization.gpu, utilization.memory, memory.used, power.draw; memory.total additionally captured in the second window
sampling.cpu_source: /proc/<pid>/stat deltas, thread counts/state/wchan; first window also /proc/<pid>/io
sampling.gpu_summary_unit: Arithmetic mean/fractions of sampled utilization readings, not continuous kernel occupancy
sampling.utc_window_start_note: Absolute sampling start timestamp was not retained; relative 0-to-40-second timing and progress events were retained

main_only_window.parent_thread_observation: Usually one runnable and nine sleeping; workers frequently pipe_read/futex waits; no D-state observed
main_only_window.interpretation: No evidence of CPU solver backlog or physical disk I/O saturation. Periodic GPU gaps coexist with an approximately one-core main process and idle solver capacity; exact producer/decoder/synchronization timing was not measured.

cls_model_setup_smoke.peak_scope: CLS process PyTorch CUDA allocated peak in the actual setup smoke; distinct from whole-device memory.used

comparison.memory_risk_observation: No material memory risk observed in the sampled window; whole-device peak 6085/32760 MiB, about18.6 percent
comparison.conclusion: Higher GPU utilization accompanied substantial main-task throughput loss; this is not cost-free use of idle GPU gaps
comparison.causal_limit: Windows use different consecutive episodes and are separated in time; this is temporal evidence consistent with shared-GPU competition, not a same-sample controlled causal comparison

root_decision_reported_after_alert.decision: Finish the remaining fixed19 cases; do not expand concurrent GPU work. Future CPU analysis may run concurrently; long GPU work should be queued serially. Keep the healthy main v1 unchanged.
root_decision_reported_after_alert.verification_scope: Decision and66/85 status supplied by root; no additional sampler or completion poll performed by this auditor

retention_limit: Summaries and retained progress intervals are saved. Full raw /proc records and every second-window GPU sample were not persisted; omitted values have not been reconstructed or guessed.
